title: Fix the ✦ voice sheet, put the mic back on the Dictate page, give the phone's mic back when the page is hidden
steps: find why the sheet is 150 px
fix the sheet height and fold the links
mic first on the Dictate Overview
release the mic on hide, resume on show

findings.text: The proof screenshots (`before-2-sheet.png`, `after-1-overview.png`, `after-3-resumed.png`) live only in the worktree's scratch (`C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/sheet-regression/public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/sheet-regression/shots/`), untracked by git — `files.jsonl` declares `shots/` but nothing under it is committed, so the proof won't survive the worktree being torn down. Worth copying the three PNGs into the landed task dir before this merges.

`after-3-resumed.png` (same shots dir) shows the sheet mid-conversation with the mic live, but no visible "resumed — listening…" text anywhere in the composer — the status span that carries that word (`Dictate.js:428`, `this.$status`) may be present but visually cramped out in the ChatPanel composer layout. Worth a quick look to confirm the resumed message is actually readable there, not just set in the DOM.

`DrawerRailSheetPanel.head()` (`ext/drawer/rail.js:552`) builds the "More" button inside `$head.append(() => …)`, where `button.c(...)` auto-appends it to `$head` via the view's capture mechanism, and then the very next line does `$head.el.insertBefore($more.el, $x)` to move it again. Harmless (insertBefore on an already-attached node just relocates it) but it's appending once and moving once for no reason — could just build the button un-captured and insert it straight into position.

answer.reply: fixed: the three PNGs are committed with git add -f under shots/.

noted: the status text is set (the proof read 'resumed — listening…' from the DOM), but the sheet's composer mic draws no status line of its own; its lit mic is what shows it is back. The Dictate page's own mic shows the word.
noted: harmless; capture-then-move keeps the button inside View's own build path.

alternative: re-measure after the panel promise resolves
